comment: Shared by sections.js and website_studio_sections.py. Section types are the real website components in homepage.json; these rules only add instance limits, ID slugs and link safety. Revisit when homepage.json or services.json is re-snapshotted or the website's routes change. Last touched: 2026-11-21.

Section0.description: Headline, two calls to action and the workflow illustration.
Section0.limitReason: The page keeps exactly one hero: it holds the only H1 and the illustration's SVG IDs.

Section1.description: Problem statement with three pain points.

Section3.description: Three service rows, each linking to a service page.

Section4.description: Four-step process line and a link to How we work.

Section5.description: Proof band linking to case studies.

Section7.limitReason: FAQ structured data must describe one visible FAQ, so the page keeps at most one.

HeroSignature.description: Positioning line and the Explore what we do link under the hero (website 215679e).
HeroSignature.limitReason: The hero has one signature line.

serviceTypes.limitReason: The page keeps exactly one intro: it holds the only H1 and the service name and description that set the page title, meta description and structured data.

serviceTypes.description: The service’s practical starting point (the Intro’s Where to start anchor).

serviceTypesComment: The sections of components/ServicePage.tsx for every service page in pages.json, by permanent INDEX (not position): type names are <typePrefix><index> (services.json). 215679e added index 5 (A practical first step) before Contact (index 4). Labels and descriptions come from the snapshot.
